rules.name: grasa-fail-pairs-cfs
rules.sql: WITH pairs(client, product) AS (VALUES ('ACL','CM S'), ('ACM','CM CRD'), ('ACM','CM CT'), ('ADP','CM KC'), ('ALG','CM CT'), ('ALV','CM SB'), ('AMC','CM CT'), ('ASI','CM CT'), ('ASI','CM DF'), ('BFA','CM CT'), ('BFL','CM SM'), ('BKP','CM C'), ('BOC','CM SM'), ('BOV','CM C'), ('BSB','CM BO'), ('BSB','CM SM'), ('CPB','CM CT'), ('CTL','CM CT'), ('DFS','CM QC'), ('FAB','CM S'), ('FMP','CM CT'), ('FMP','CM S'), ('FSI','CM CRD'), ('GIL','CM CT'), ('HSD','CM C'), ('IOL','CM BO'), ('IOL','CM RS'), ('IVO','CM SM'), ('KMI','CM CT'), ('KTE','CM S'), ('LIB','CM CT'), ('LIT','CM CT'), ('LMB','CM S'), ('MAO','CM W'), ('MDA','CM QC'), ('MLK','CM C'), ('MLK','CM S'), ('MLK','CM SM'), ('MLK','CM W'), ('OMF','CM KC'), ('ORM','CM C'), ('ORM','CM MW'), ('SCE','CM CT'), ('SCW','CM CT'), ('SEC','CM CT'), ('SIC','CM S'), ('SIP','CM OR EUR'), ('SLC','CM CT'), ('SLC','CM S'), ('SMH','CM OR'), ('SMT','CM CT'), ('TAE','CM S'), ('TER','CM SB'), ('TFC','CM S'), ('TVE','CM S'), ('UDA','CM C'), ('UNF','CM KO'), ('VCI','CM OR'), ('VZN','CM S')), vd AS (SELECT value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), sec AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.client, p.product, c.contract_month, c.security_id FROM opera.helper_sensitivity_report_view_cache_table c JOIN pairs p ON upper(substring(c.contract_number, 1, 3)) = upper(p.client) AND upper(trim(c.product_code)) = upper(trim(p.product)) WHERE upper(trim(c.business_unit)) = :bu) SELECT s.client, s.product, s.contract_month, (SELECT value_date FROM vd) AS value_date, COUNT(*) AS securities, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.security_id IS NULL) AS sec_no_master, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.security_id IS NOT NULL AND m.status <> 'Active') AS sec_inactive, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'Active' AND m.vol1_id IS NULL) AS sec_no_vol1, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'Active' AND m.vol1_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table sv WHERE sv.vol_id = m.vol1_id AND sv.value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM vd))) AS sec_no_surface, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'Active' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM opera.settlement_vol_surf_table sv WHERE sv.vol_id = m.vol1_id AND sv.value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM vd))) AS sec_with_surface, string_agg(DISTINCT m.derivative_type, ',') AS derivative_types FROM sec s LEFT JOIN opera.cloned_security_info_table m ON m.security_id = s.security_id AND upper(m.business_unit) = :bu GROUP BY s.client, s.product, s.contract_month ORDER BY s.client, s.product, s.contract_month
